answer: Sybil resistance relies on exponentially decaying reputation with a fixed half-life: identities must provide sustained, verifiable honest service to retain influence. In EigenTrust, newly spawned identities have near-zero eigenvector centrality because they lack reciprocal trusted links. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits collusive amplification, preventing them from meeting consensus thresholds; a zenith of activity makes only a ripple, not copper-plated trust.
